nodes.title: An approval sheet that offers the hold before the change's details have loaded
nodes.tried: The approval sheet fetched the change's arguments (amount, cap, audience) in a useEffect, while 'Hold to approve' was available at once.
nodes.broke: On a slow request a person could approve a ₹500 top-up without the ₹500 on screen. The web builder found it in the audit for the run-before-library pattern.
nodes.instead: The sheet shows a loading line and no hold until the arguments are in. If they fail to load, the hold is disabled with a reason: not safe to approve blind. A 14th browser flow holds /v1/actions back 1.5 s; it failed on the old sheet and passes on the fix. The audit of the other screens was by code reading only, not runtime delays.
